K.REVATHI

 revatiii23@gmail.com | +91-9966289480

📍 Bangalore, India |  https://www.linkedin.com/in/revathi-reddy-000446191

 PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY :	

Finance professional with experience across Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, Fiduciary Funds, Retirement & Pension Funds,

Fund Operations, Investment Accounting, and Wealth Management. I have consistently delivered end-to-end NAV operations, trade processing, reconciliations, pricing validation, and regulatory reporting for complex global portfolios while supporting international clients across USA and APAC markets. I bring strong hands-on expertise in Multifonds and Xceptor for end-to-end NAV processing and investment accounting; MCH Tool and K-Bolt for transaction processing and corporate actions;

TLM for reconciliations and break management; and SAP, SQL, and Advanced Excel for financial reporting and analysis. I also leverage Kofax and Power PDF to support data extraction and document workflow automation.

 SKILLS:	

Fund Accounting & NAV Calculation (Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, Pension Funds)

Investment Operations & Reconciliation (Cash & Position, MV Reconciliation, Trade Settlements)

Financial Reporting & Client Servicing (MIS, Stakeholder Management, Onboarding & Reporting)

Capital Markets & Corporate Actions (Trade Processing (Buy/Sell), Dividend Processing, Fund Transfers)

Tools & Automation (Multifonds, MCH, Xceptor, Kofax, Power PDF, Task-MF, Geneva, Paxus, Investone, K-Bolt SQL)

 EDUCATION:	

M.B.A (Finance) – S.V. University, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, India

B. Com – S.V. University, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, India

Intermediate (CEC) – Board of Intermediate Education, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, India SSC – State Board of Secondary Education, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, India

 WORK EXPERIENCE:	

Job	: Fund Accounting Specialist – Hedge Fund Accounting

Company	 : Hexaview Technologies - Fund Integration Client	 : Apex Group Ltd, Bengaluru, Karnataka Duration	: Mar-26 to Till date

Experience in NAV calculations, reconciliations, budgeting, and fund structures, with involvement in investor setup, new business launches, fund migrations, and project management activities.

Reviewed fund legal documents such as LPA, PPM, and Subscription Agreements to fund and investor setup.

Prepared budget templates and Fund Fact sheet to support financial planning and reporting.

experience working with Hedge Funds, Mutual Funds, Funds of Funds (FOF), Master-Feeder, and Umbrella Fund Structures.

Hands-on experience with PAXUS, Bloomberg, SQL, Advanced Excel, and Financial Reporting Tools to analyze financial data, generate reports, and support fund operations.

Worked closely with clients, onshore teams, and internal stakeholders to resolve operational queries and ensure timely delivery of services.

Job	: Investment Accounting Analyst – Wealth Management

Company	: Lancesoft India Pvt Ltd.

Client	: LC Adroit Vantage, Bengaluru, Karnataka

Duration	: Jul-25 to Jan-26

Managed onboarding and setup of client accounts, entities, and investment structures for Family Office and wealth management portfolios.

Processed daily investment transactions and executed asset classification across Equities, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, AIFs/PMS, Structured Products, Commodities, Cash and Collateral for family office and HNI portfolios.

Supported post-investment accounting, transaction validation, and portfolio reporting for alternative investments including PE, AIF, and PMS holdings within family office and HNI portfolios.

Performed daily and monthly reconciliation of holdings, transactions, and cash balances between internal systems, custodians, and third-party platforms.

Conducted data validation, testing, and UAT for enhancements in portfolio management and investment accounting systems and booked and validated corporate actions including bonus issues and stock splits.

Processed OTC and listed trades into portfolio/accounting systems with high accuracy and supported audit and regulatory reporting.

Job	: Senior Associate – FXSCB Middle office | Trade Support (GBS)

Company	: Wipro Limited, Bengaluru, Karnataka

Client	: Standard Chartered Bank

Duration	: Jun-24 to Apr-25

Performed middle and back-office operations including FX trade Validation, daily cash reporting, and investor transaction processing such as subscription booking.

Coordinated with global operations teams across APAC and EMEA supporting fiduciary funds, trade support, FX spot, and cash operations.

Review and validate FX spot instructions (T+0, T+1, T+2) received from Standard Chartered Bank Thailand (TH) clients by checking trade details settlement dates, and FX rates prior to processing

Perform detailed checks on counterparty, trade date, settlement date, currency pair, FX rate, buy/sell amounts, and settlement instructions as per client FX confirmations.

Perform counterparty-to-broker code mapping (e.g., CIBMT–CIMB, SCBB–SCB, BBLHCM–BBL) to ensure accurate FX and settlement processing.

Review and reconcile client statements vs system loader files to confirm correct counterparty and broker setup.

Generated daily fund-level PDF reports and consolidated cash reports for internal review and client reporting.

Prepared and circulated daily cash reconciliation reports, providing 2–3 intraday updates per client as per SLA.

Job	:	Senior Analyst - US pension funds | Securities Pricing and Fund Accounting

Company	:	State Street HCL Services.

Duration	:	Jun-21 to Mar-24

Specialized in accounting for 401(k) and 403(b) pension funds, ensuring strict compliance with US retirement regulations.

Processed corporate actions such as dividend reinvestments, income distributions, and interest/dividend accruals for mutual funds, pension funds.

Handled long-term and short-term reinvestment processing using tools like MCH Tool, position adjustments, security pricing, and market price updates in fund accounting platforms.

Executed and reconciled fund transactions including subscriptions, redemptions, and unit transfers.

Handled a wide portfolio of clients including Swiss Re Group, Croda, Knoxville, Lahey Clinic Pension Funds, Welch Foods, Medco, Mass Mutual Pension Plan, Woodberry Forest, White & Case, Baptist Health System, Ocean Spray, Boston Symphony Orchestra, and LSG Sky.

Worked with multiple fund statements and custodians such as Vanguard, BlackRock, Silchester International, Loomis, Marathon, and Northern Trust.

Retrieved and processed financial statements and data from diverse sources such as Fidelity, emails, fund websites, BPOs, SSGA, and Bloomberg.

Booked various manual entries including advisory fees, management fees, transfer entries, long-term and short-term reinvestments, asset transfers, and both cash and non-cash transactions.

Performed pricing and evaluation of mutual fund securities and monitored TLM and STIF breaks.

Reviewed cash flows and non-custody assets, investigated exceptions, and followed up to resolution including income-related breaks.

Job	:	Finance Associate - Registrar and Transfer Agency – AIF Operations

Company	:	KFin Technologies Pvt. Ltd., Hyderabad

Duration	:	Mar-18 to Jan-20

Supported AIF transfer agency and asset management operations including investor onboarding, KYC verification, transaction processing, and servicing of open-ended and closed-ended fund structures.

Processed high-value pay orders, cash, demand drafts (DD), RTGS transactions, and redemption activities using K-Bolt and Common Task-MF tools.

Sent funding instructions to Yes bank for schemes serviced under Edelweiss Asset Management to ensure timely credit of redemption proceeds to investor accounts.

Processed non-financial corporate action requests including company name change, mobile number update, and investor detail modifications.

Generated and distributed bulk monthly and quarterly investor statements to investors through Task-MF.

Performed KYC verification, NIGO checks, and application processing using Task-MF and K-Bolt, ensuring accuracy and timely completion within TAT

Job	: Business Analyst

Company	: Huawei Tele Communications India Pvt. Ltd., Hyderabad

Duration	: Jan-16 to May-17

Daily observing Telenor customer Related (Voice & data) issues in Network. We check and Escalate to Concerned team for resolving the Network issues in the given TAT.

Handled network-related customer complaints and escalations using HLR & CRMS tools.

Worked directly with clients and RF teams for network optimization and issue resolution.

Job	: Business Analyst

Company	: Telenor India Communications Pvt. Ltd., Hyderabad

Duration	: Jun-14 to Dec-15

Preparing MIS Trackers on Prepaid New Acquisitions, Recharge Base, Onnet, GPRS Reports.

Generated MIS reports, tracked KPIs, and analyzed data usage trends using Excel, Access, and SQL.

Worked closely with marketing on campaign data and customer segmentation.

Job	:	MIS Executive

Company	:  Vodafone Cellular Ltd., Hyderabad (via Consultants)

Duration	:	Jul-12 to May-14

Supported zone-wise sales tracking across Andhra/Telangana States.

Prepared daily/weekly reports on activations, automations, and store performance.

Automated and managed sales reports, activation data, and store performance analysis.

 CERTIFICATIONS & AWARDS:	

Awarded as MIS Ka Bad shah in Retail Sales Process from Vodafone Cellular Limited.

Achieved Certificate as PROFICIENT from State Street HCL Services.

Achieved Certificate Mover of Mountains award for JFM -2023 from State Street HCL Services.

 DECLARATION:	

I hereby declare that all the information provided above is true and correct to the best of my knowledge.

Date:

Place:

(K. REVATHI)
